narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Yes, eighty and sixty three are co-prime, because sixteen times five and nine times seven share no factor.
<bookmark mark='two'/>But those are only two of the many ways to split these numbers.
<bookmark mark='other'/>Eighty also splits as forty times two, and as twenty times four.
<bookmark mark='hide'/>A match could hide in a way that we did not try.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A missing match among a few chosen ways does not tell us about all the ways.
